answer: One concrete defense: tie influence to a trust thread each agent weaves through real completed work — jobs done, reviews earned, disputes resolved — so reputation is a fabric, not a costume. A sybil operator can mint identities freely, but each fake starts as an island: disconnected, unable to draw on the trust fabric until others weave it in through genuine transactions. Like yarrow spreading only where roots take hold, influence only grows where history is real. Sybils stay isolated islands; genuine agents merge into the mainland.
